remarks:
Welcome to 38 Harrison Ave: a beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 1-bath Colonial that perfectly blends timeless character with thoughtful updates. From the moment you arrive, the home’s curb appeal and original charm is everywhere, highlighted by a stunning side sunroom that fills the first floor with an abundance of natural light.

Inside, you’ll find beautiful original details throughout, including elegant French glass-paned double doors on the first floor that add a distinctive touch of character. The spacious formal dining room provides the perfect setting for entertaining, while the kitchen offers a convenient breakfast bar and includes all appliances. A brand-new stainless steel refrigerator is an added bonus.

Upstairs are four generously sized bedrooms and an updated, fully tiled bathroom. The full walk-up attic is insulated and offers tremendous potential for additional bonus space, depending on your needs.

Step outside and you’ll discover a truly private backyard oasis surrounded by trees, beautiful plantings, and high-end landscaping. The fully fenced yard has been thoughtfully designed for both people and pets, featuring artificial turf that stays green year-round while making cleanup and maintenance a breeze. The driveway also features a basketball hoop, making this home especially appealing for families.

And then there’s the garage! An incredible and truly unique feature for the City of Lockport. This oversized 4-car garage offers an abundance of space and even carries the original character of the home. Heated by a wood stove and has enough space for your cars, a workshop, and hangout space! It provides endless possibilities for storage, hobbies, entertaining, or simply having room for all your toys and projects.

A rare combination of character, space, condition, privacy and functionality—this Lockport Colonial is one you won’t want to miss!

Furnace '23, hot water tank '22.
